task_completion.description: Agent opens and reads the target coordinates from ~/Desktop/eo_targets.txt.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal window showing the contents of eo_targets.txt with coordinates for Washington DC, Beijing, and Moscow.

task_completion.description: Agent calculates the Ground Station Minimum Elevation Angle based on the 30-degree off-nadir constraint.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Calculations shown in a scratchpad, terminal, or script comments. The value should be approximately 57.37 degrees.

task_completion.description: Agent configures the GMAT (General Mission Analysis Tool) environment with the satellite orbit, ground stations (cities), and sensors.
task_completion.visual_evidence: GMAT GUI or script editor showing the definition of a 500km sun-synchronous orbit and the three target locations.

task_completion.description: Agent sets up ContactLocators or scripts to identify valid imaging passes using the calculated elevation angle.
task_completion.visual_evidence: GMAT script or GUI panel showing 'ContactLocator' or 'Contact' resources configured with the minimum elevation angle (~57.4 deg).

task_completion.description: Agent saves the simulation script to the specified output path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer or terminal showing agile_targeting.script exists in ~/GMAT_output/.

task_completion.description: Agent creates the final accessibility_summary.txt with the pass counts for each city.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal showing the content of ~/GMAT_output/accessibility_summary.txt containing Washington DC, Beijing, Moscow, and their respective pass counts.

integrity.description: The agent used the GMAT software or its scripting language rather than guessing results.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the GMAT interface, GMAT execution logs, or the specific syntax of a .script file.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo the final counts without running a simulation.
integrity.visual_evidence: Evidence of the simulation running (progress bars, output logs) before the summary file is created.

integrity.description: The agent used the calculated elevation angle (~57.4) rather than a default value like 10 or 15 degrees.
integrity.visual_evidence: The value 57.37 (or rounded equivalent) appearing in the GMAT script or GUI settings.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The Ground Station Minimum Elevation Angle for a 500km orbit and 30-degree off-nadir angle is approximately 57.37 degrees. The agent must use this value (or a range between 56.0 and 58.5) to filter valid passes. The final report must be at ~/GMAT_output/accessibility_summary.txt and include counts for Washington DC, Beijing, and Moscow. The script must be saved at ~/GMAT_output/agile_targeting.script.
